rune.browser.engine.fault.blocked: {{host}} refused the download (HTTP {{status}}). Your network or administrator may not allow it.

rune.browser.engine.fault.connect: Couldn't connect to {{host}}. Check your connection, then try again.
rune.browser.engine.fault.corrupt: The download didn't match its checksum, so it was deleted and nothing was installed. Retry downloads it again.
rune.browser.engine.fault.damaged: Files of the installed browser are missing or damaged (code {{code}}), so it was removed. Retry downloads it again.
rune.browser.engine.fault.dirs: Couldn't find a folder for the browser's files ({{error}}).

rune.browser.engine.fault.noMemory: There wasn't enough memory to install the browser. Close some apps, then try again: the download continues from where it stopped.
rune.browser.engine.fault.noSpace: The browser needs {{need}} MB of disk space and {{free}} MB are free. Free some space, then try again.
rune.browser.engine.fault.notPublished: This build can't download the browser yet: it isn't published for this platform. An update will bring it.
rune.browser.engine.fault.offline: Couldn't find {{host}}. Check that you're online, then try again.
rune.browser.engine.fault.outOfMemory: The browser closed because the computer ran out of memory. Close some apps, then try again.
rune.browser.engine.fault.prevented: Windows or your security software stopped the browser from starting ({{error}}). Allow it there, then try again.
rune.browser.engine.fault.proxy: Your proxy couldn't connect to {{host}}. Check your proxy settings, then try again.

rune.browser.engine.fault.signer: {{file}} in the download is signed by {{signer}}, not the browser's publisher, so nothing was installed.
rune.browser.engine.fault.stopped: The browser stopped unexpectedly. Retry starts it again.
rune.browser.engine.fault.unexpected: {{host}} answered with a page instead of the browser download. If your network asks you to sign in, sign in, then try again.
rune.browser.engine.fault.unsigned: {{file}} in the download isn't signed by the browser's publisher, so nothing was installed.
